method: All 150 source frames inspected in chronological labelled contact sheets; 11 native-resolution hero crops and the original Idle capture0 were inspected for detail. No actual movie/audio playback was used. This is sequence inspection at retained 20Hz capture intervals.
timing_boundary: Labels use capture index/20 nominal seconds; exact evaluated animation phase at first capture is not independently supplied. Do not infer a gameplay timing defect from the preview wrap.
global_visible_problems: Flat shield and blade construction; flat chest plus capped polygonal shoulders.
Shallow generic face, stacked finger bands and abrupt cuff transitions.
Tubular pale legs, rigid separated navy panels and bulbous faceted boots.

findings.observed: Shield stays below the face; feet remain visually planted in this frontal gallery view. The face remains a small shallow-featured shell, shoulders are faceted caps, chest is a flat plate, and skirt/legs have detached rectangular and tubular readings. Breathing is too subtle to assess from these montage previews; images differ, so no frozen-animation claim is made.
findings.followup: Use the identical gallery camera to compare face, shoulder construction, breastplate wrap and a calm clear idle.

findings.observed: Alternating raised legs and planted opposite boots are visible. Straight pale leg tubes, sharp boot cuffs and rigid navy hip panels remain conspicuous at the two step extrema. Hands and equipment stay visually attached at this scale, but fine contact cannot be certified from the frontal view.
findings.followup: Compare knee/sleeve/coat transitions at both step extrema; measure floor support from evaluated geometry rather than these shadows.

findings.observed: A recognizable inward sword sweep crosses the torso. At captures 4-6 the blade and breastplate share similar values and flatten into one band; the tip overlaps the shield silhouette. The right bracer/palm junction appears abrupt with a dark cuff opening, and the fingers read as stacked bands around the handle. The face remains visible.
findings.followup: Preserve release timing while checking the new forged blade thickness, hand wrap, cuff continuity and shield clearance at these exact sampled poses. The frontal images do not prove a geometric interpenetration.

findings.observed: The shield lift is obvious, but captures 2-5 cover much of the face and torso; capture 3 hides both eyes behind the broad top edge and capture 4 leaves only part of the face visible. The shield still reads as a thick flat panel. The pose later returns the shield below the face.
findings.followup: Inspect approved convex shield and forehead/eye readability during lift and recovery. Brief active occlusion is recorded for judgment; the idle visibility rule is not conflated with this active pose.

findings.observed: Torso recoils while the sword arm extends. At captures 2-4 the blade is strongly foreshortened and difficult to recognize in the small montage; the native crop confirms it is present. The chest plate pivots as a large isolated slab over the coat and the shoulder/cuff construction remains angular.
findings.followup: Check new ribcage/chest relationship and rigid-armor clearance under recoil; do not report an absent weapon based on a small foreshortened image.

findings.observed: The sequence visibly lowers into a kneel/bow, with the shield nearly horizontal. Captures 12-18 expose the layered cuff/hand/shield-back construction and a rigid navy panel around the bent knee. Capture 18 is kneeling and 19 is standing, a sharp captured reset with some edge ghosting.
findings.followup: Treat 18-to-19 as a gallery preview/capture wrap until actual phase and non-looping game state are checked. This is not evidence of gameplay resurrection. Inspect wrist/strap alignment, knee cloth and the held final defeat pose independently.

findings.observed: A modest shield lift/lean occurs while feet stay planted and the face remains visible. At the montage size the gesture is close to the idle silhouette; the blocky chest/shoulder/boot construction dominates more than personality.
findings.followup: Preserve existing timing and compare whether the improved shapes read distinctly. A more expressive animation is not silently authorized by this visual observation.

not_reviewed: Continuous movie playback at real-time speed
Rear/side wrist contact and exact interpenetration
